name: gate_room
description: Room mic — gated room for punch; closes between drum hits to tighten the ambience
notes: Room mics need a gentler gate: -40dB range preserves natural-sounding bleed rather than going silent. Longer attack (8ms) smooths the gate open without the 'click' that fast-attack room gating causes. 200ms hold and 150ms release keep the room tail sounding organic.
